overview: The player-list packet manages tab list entries: add, remove, and updates of game mode, ping and display name. Server-side anticheats almost never validate it, and in this corpus only Grim consumes it: one listener rewrites game modes to hide spectators, and the entity replication listener stores the UUID-to-profile mappings that checks use to resolve entity identities. The keyword noise in the corpus is tab-complete and math-table code, not player-list handling.

checks.name: Spectator hiding in the player list (Grim)
checks.purpose: Prevent spectators on Grim's spectate system from leaking through the tab list with spectator game mode.
checks.how_it_works: PacketHidePlayerInfo is a HIGHEST-priority send listener. For PLAYER_INFO (pre-1.19.3) it walks the player data list and, for entries that should be hidden, rewrites SPECTATOR game mode to SURVIVAL, cancels the packet when every entry was hidden and the action was a pure game-mode update, and marks the packet for re-encoding otherwise. The 1.19.3+ PLAYER_INFO_UPDATE path does the same per entry, removes the UPDATE_GAME_MODE action from a cancelled packet, and re-encodes modified entries.
checks.detects: Not a cheat detection: it hides the anticheat's own spectators from other players' tab lists, which also removes the game-mode tell that would expose staff spectating.
checks.variations: No other anticheat in the corpus touches player-list packets; the rest of the S38 corpus hits are tab-complete (C0B) or table-name keyword noise.

checks.name: Player-list replication (Grim)
checks.purpose: Record the UUID-to-profile mappings announced on the player list so entity and profile lookups in checks resolve correctly.
checks.how_it_works: PacketEntityReplication wraps PLAYER_INFO and PLAYER_INFO_UPDATE sends and, transaction-sandwiched, puts ADD_PLAYER game profiles into compensatedEntities.profiles and removes them on REMOVE_PLAYER. The profile map feeds checks that need the game profile behind an entity id or uuid.
checks.detects: None directly; it is state replication that keeps the compensated entity model consistent with the tab list.
checks.variations: No other anticheat in the corpus reads player-list packets; Grim's SpectateManager is the only consumer of the stored profiles besides the checks themselves.
